_readme: Single source of truth for levels and XP rules. Edit curve/tiers/xp here, then run `python shared/generate_levels.py`: it rewrites `thresholds` and `reference_days` below and syncs backend/app/engines/learn/levels.json, frontend/lib/levels/levels.json and supabase_xp_levels_data.sql. Tests on every side fail when a copy differs.

sources.preflop_trainer: correct 1 XP, +1 per 10-hand streak (max 4); mixed 1; wrong 0. Enforced in record_preflop_trainer_hand.
sources.flop_equity: equity guess within 3 = 2, within 7 = 1; nut advantage +1; c-bet band +1, size +1 (max 5). Quick Fire: 1 per right pick. Enforced in record_flop_trainer_answer / record_flop_versus_answer.
sources.streak_bonus: +percent of trainer XP once the day streak users see (activity_streak: days in a row with trainer hands or XP, own time zone) reaches min_streak_days, at most daily_max per day.
sources.hand_review: xp for the first hand-history import of the UTC day.
sources.daily_cap: trainer XP per UTC day, preflop and flop together. Bonuses come on top and have their own limits.

reference_player._readme: Who the curve is calibrated on: free limit, preflop trainer only, 65% correct. xp_per_action = 0.65 * (1 + 0.65^10 + 0.65^20 + 0.65^30), the streak tiers of record_preflop_trainer_hand.
